description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named TransactionController that handles HTTP POST requests for fund transfer and utility payment transactions related to banking services.

classes.name: TransactionController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller managing transaction-related endpoints for fund transfer and utility payments.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Handles POST requests for fund transfer, invokes transactionService.fundTransfer, logs the process.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Handles POST requests for utility payments, invokes transactionService.utilPayment, logs the process.
